items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: I loved Bill Harris and I was hugely influenced by him... He had a sound that was as luscious, Bill Harris — Bill Harris — Bill Watrous years later

ctx.x: What was it like, going back to Woody Herman for a moment — what was it like to follow Bill Harris and play tunes that featured him and now they feature you.

I loved Bill Harris and I was hugely influenced by him. When I was in high school I had a band at Phillips Exeter, believe it or not, playing all the charts I wanted to play. And I wrote out [scats] “Everywhere,” which was a big feature for Bill Harris, 1946 Carnegie Hall concert [scats] and the beautiful ending and all this sort of thing.
